# BraVL attribution
BraVL backbone files derive from the local BraVL project (MIT, copyright 2022 Changde Du). See `bravl/LICENSE`. Files listed in docs/backbone_provenance.json are exact copies from the archived experiment snapshot. Other Python support files were filled from the local upstream checkout. No claim is made that this reconstructs an upstream Git commit or exactly matches a server environment. Preserve these notices when redistributing. The SIVR addition is a training regularizer on this backbone; cite Du et al., Decoding visual neural representations by multimodal learning of brain-visual-linguistic features, IEEE TMM, 2023, and the eventual SIVR paper.
